narration: In month {fork_month}, a cousin came with a scheme promising a fixed return every month, and he wanted you in. You chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, and the ghost finished {life_gap}, its month holding slightly less beyond the plain necessities.
